title: Horizontal Asymptote of a Rational Function
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Find the horizontal asymptotes of f(x) = (3x^2 - 5x + 2) / (5x^2 + 4x - 1) by evaluating limits as x -> +-oo.
finalAnswer: \lim_{x \to \pm \infty} f(x) = \frac{3}{5} \implies y = \frac{3}{5} \text{ is a horizontal asymptote}

steps.title: Divide Numerator and Denominator by Highest Power x^2
steps.explanation: Divide every term by x^2 to expose terms that approach zero.
steps.why: Standard technique for rational limits at infinity.

steps.title: Apply the Reciprocal Limit Theorem
steps.explanation: Every term with x in the denominator approaches zero as x -> infinity.
steps.why: Reciprocal limit rule lim 1/x^r = 0 for r > 0.

steps.title: Compute the Limit
steps.explanation: Substitute the zero limits into the expression.
steps.why: The limit of a quotient is the quotient of limits.
